title: Aaya jo karbala me mohammed ka gharaana
body:
Aaya jo karbala me mohd ka gharana , Ab hashr talak hoga yahi'n inka thikaana , 1) Kaise kahu ke badla hai yeh pal me zamaana , Hai ek dile Zahra kayi teero ka nishaana
